mapper.update: update member_room_info set status=#{status} where room_id in (${roomIds}) and deleted = 0
mapper.select: select r.room_name `key`, r.room_id `value` from member_room_info r left join member_store_user su ON su.store_id = r.store_id where r.deleted = 0 and r.store_id = #{storeId} and su.deleted = 0 and su.user_id = #{userId} order by sort_id asc
select * from member_room_info where deleted = 0 and store_id = #{storeId} order by sort_id
select image_urls from member_room_info where deleted = 0 and room_id = #{roomId}
select r.room_name `key`, r.room_id `value` from member_room_info r where r.deleted = 0 and r.store_id = #{storeId} order by sort_id asc
